title: How Payments Post to a Specialty Pharmacy Program Enrollment
content:
A payment on a Specialty Pharmacy Program enrollment lowers the enrollment's balance due and names the shipped fill it pays.

## Rules

- **Order of application.** Member payments are applied to the oldest unpaid fill first.
- **Ways to pay and when payments post.**
  - Member payments are taken by card, by HSA/FSA card or by check.
  - Assistance payments post automatically when assistance is applied.
  - Foundation grants post when the foundation pays.
- **Ceiling.** A payment never exceeds the unpaid cost share of the fill it pays.

## Sources of payment

| Who pays | How the payment arises |
|---|---|
| The member | A payment by card, HSA/FSA card or check, applied to the oldest unpaid fill first |
| A manufacturer program | Posts automatically when assistance is applied to a fill |
| A foundation | Posts when the foundation pays a grant |

## Oldest-first, worked through (assumed figures)

An enrollment has two shipped fills with unpaid cost share: fill 1 (older) with $40.00 unpaid and fill 2 (newer) with $65.00 unpaid. A member payment is applied first to fill 1, which is the oldest unpaid fill. A payment on fill 1 is never more than its $40.00 unpaid cost share.

## Point of judgement

*A member wants to pay $100.00 on a fill whose unpaid cost share is $65.00.* A payment never exceeds the unpaid cost share of the fill it pays, so a payment on that fill is at most $65.00.
